title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks reused by every v1 data file. Encodings follow the C2SP specs for tree hashes (base64) and sha256sum for file digests (lowercase hex).

logName.description: Short name of a transparency log, as used in paths (data/v1/<log>/...).

origin.description: Checkpoint origin line (C2SP tlog-checkpoint), e.g. transparency.diagnos.health/audit/v1.

keyName.description: Signed-note key name: no spaces and no '+'.

keyHash.description: Signed-note key ID: the first 4 bytes of SHA-256(name || 0x0A || alg || pubkey), as 8 lowercase hex digits.

logUrl.description: Public read URL of a tlog-tiles log, with a trailing slash.

time.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with second precision.

treeSize.description: Number of leaves in a Merkle tree. Kept below 2^53 so that every JSON reader gets the exact value.

treeHash.description: A 32-byte SHA-256 Merkle tree hash in standard base64, exactly as it appears in a checkpoint.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of some bytes in lowercase hex, as printed by sha256sum.

oid.description: An ASN.1 object identifier in dotted form.

provider.description: Short name of an RFC 3161 time-stamping authority. Its CA chain is published at keys/tsa/<provider>.pem.

witnessPath.description: Repository path of a witness record; the file name is the UTC time of the cosignature.

findingPath.description: Repository path of a finding record.

timestampPath.description: Repository path of an hourly timestamp record.

tokenPath.description: Repository path of a raw RFC 3161 TimeStampResp (DER).

signedNote.description: The exact text of a C2SP signed note: a body ending in a newline, a blank line, then one or more signature lines '— <name> <base64>' each ending in a newline.

treeHead.description: A tree size and the root hash at that size.

consistencyProof.description: RFC 9162 section 2.1.4 consistency proof, as base64 tree hashes. At most 2*64 nodes.

findingKind.description: equivocation: two log-signed checkpoints with the same size and different roots. rollback: a log-signed checkpoint smaller than one already witnessed. inconsistent: a larger checkpoint whose consistency proof does not verify.

findingSummary.description: A finding as listed by latest.json and the month index.

serviceId.description: Short, stable name of an audited service, as used in paths and in /healthz (frontend, vault, sign, status).

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of an audited service: https, a host, and a single trailing slash.

dimension.description: One of the three audited properties.

level.description: ok: the check passed. warn: degraded, or the auditor could not confirm. fail: the check failed or there is evidence of a problem. none: not measured.

slot.description: The start of a five-minute slot: a UTC instant whose minutes are a multiple of five and whose seconds are zero.

dayLetters.description: One letter per five-minute slot of a UTC day (288): o ok, w warn, f fail, - none or not measured.

dayRuns.description: One digit per five-minute slot of a UTC day (288): 1 if the auditor recorded a run in that slot, 0 if not.

windowLetters.description: One letter per UTC day of a 90-day window, oldest first: o ok, w warn, f fail, - none or not measured.

gitCommit.description: A full Git commit hash (SHA-1), lowercase hex.

gitBlob.description: A Git blob hash (SHA-1) as GitHub reports it, lowercase hex.

version.description: A release version as the service reports it (semantic version, optionally with build metadata).

incidentId.description: Identifier of a declared incident: the declaration date and a slug (which must not start with "auto-", that is for the incidents the auditor opens itself). It is also the file name, incidents/<id>.md. The incidents of both kinds are told apart by their source.

autoIncidentId.description: Identifier of an incident the auditor opened on its own: the UTC day of the first slot of the problem, "auto", the service, the category (a availability, i integrity) and the time of that slot (HHMM), e.g. 2026-10-01-auto-vault-a-0310. It is also the prefix of the file names of its event facts. A declared incident may not use a slug that starts with "auto-".

incidentCategory.description: What an incident is about: C confidentiality, I integrity, A availability. An incident colours the dimensions of its categories on the services it affects.

incidentCategories.description: A non-empty set of incident categories, always written in the order C, I, A.

incidentSeverity.description: low and medium colour the affected dimension yellow; high and critical, red.

ciaIncidentEventPath.description: Repository path of one event of an automatic incident: <incident id>-<seq>.json under the UTC day of the run that wrote it.

localizedText.description: The same plain text in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

ciaRunPath.description: Repository path of a CIA run record; the file name is the slot (HHMM, UTC).

ciaIncidentsPath.description: Repository path of an incidents snapshot; the file name is the slot (HHMM, UTC) of the run that read it.

releaseVerdictPath.description: Repository path of the auditor's verdict on one release of one service, under the release's manifest digest.

releaseFilePath.description: Repository path of a piece of release evidence archived by the auditor.

ciaRunLink.description: A CIA run record and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

ciaIncidentsLink.description: An incidents snapshot and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

checkCode.description: Machine-readable reason of a check result. The allowed values per check are listed in cia-run.schema.json.
